name: The built-in Administrator account is enabled
description: The account with RID 500 (Administrator, renamed or localized) is enabled: it cannot be locked out by failed sign-ins and is the first account an attacker tries. Use a named account with administrator rights and leave this one disabled.
remediation: Disable it: `Disable-LocalUser -SID (Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.SID -like '*-500' }).SID` (keep another administrator first).
